method: Final decoded MP3; independent HPSS multiband spectral candidate detection (1024/128), then causal ~1ms PCM energy attack-start refinement. Strong events require upper 75% spectral strength and >=0.72 local energy-rise confidence. Calibration uses known PCM starts and applies no fitted global correction. Signed residual = chart minus nearest strong attack. Snap bounded to 65ms and minimum 315ms spacing. Unmatched weak passages retain their beat-derived timing.
limitations: Nearest percussion proximity is not perceptual beat correctness. Dense syncopation can make event identity ambiguous. Slow vocal ramps and weak/sustained music do not provide precise physical attack ground truth; unmatched turns remain estimates. Same detector guides refinement and after measurement, so improved proximity is a consistency metric, not independent proof. No human listening/playtest claim. Chapter cues estimate PCM/timbre changes within broad story windows, not manual bar/verse annotations. Tempo autocorrelation can contain half/double and syncopated pulses.

calibration.fixture: 31 known PCM burst starts; bass/mid/high tone + seeded noise; 1/4/8ms attack ramps, three levels, sustained background. No global compensation fitted.

heldOutDetector.signal: first-difference PCM energy; independent peaks; 20% rise crossing; never used for snapping
